brief:
Gaza's Civil Defense has warned of a preventable catastrophe as more than 40,000 Palestinians shelter in structurally unsound buildings damaged by bombing, Mondoweiss reported. The agency describes conditions as a "nightmare" ahead of winter, with collapse-prone structures posing an immediate threat to displaced residents seeking refuge.

The situation reflects the broader humanitarian crisis facing Gaza's population, where widespread destruction of housing stock has left civilians with limited shelter options as temperatures drop and weather conditions worsen.
dek: With more than 40,000 Palestinians sheltering in collapse-prone buildings and a “nightmare” winter approaching, Gaza’s Civil Defense warns of a preventable catastrophe unfolding in plain sight.
title: Gaza's Civil Defense warns of imminent collapse catastrophe in bombed buildings
